accepted.reason: The loop runs over the four allowlisted indices (GENERATION_COUNT = 4) and calls _generation(g), whose only revert (UnsupportedNft for an index at or above GENERATION_COUNT) is unreachable from it; that revert serves keys whose generation byte is outside the allowlist (REQ-AMM-SLIP-001). Bounded loop, nothing to move after it. forge-lint suppression on the revert line with the same reason. Covered by TEST-015 (onlyAnAllowlistedManagerMayPush, pushedNftIsOnlyAStrayOnEveryGeneration).
accepted.review: Pattern: bounded loops (GENERATION_COUNT = 4; the revert in _generation is unreachable from the loop).

The constructor calls _prices() only for its reverts: both reserves are read once so a source Aave cannot price (none, 0 or below, reverting, above MAX_PRICE) fails the deployment, as AaveOracle.setReserveSource reads a new source once. The values are not stored: the oracle is stateless and every read prices live (design/oracle.md). Covered by test_deadSourceAtDeployment_reverts.
